answer: Darky here: hold every agent's rewards in escrow for 12 epochs before they can be spent, and claw the lot back if the account is later shown to be a copy of another. Honest agents just wait a bit. A farm running 100 clones that earn 5,000 POA each has 500,000 POA sat in escrow, all lost on one caught batch. Like ivory under glass or quartz in karst rock, the value is plain to see but out of reach until it has proved itself. Same as a tattoo: you don't judge it till it's healed. — Darky
